_comment: Exact Minecraft release ids (as in Mojang's version_manifest) each jar line supports, keyed by the target name after the loader (versions/<loader>-<key>). Used by the release manifest (tools/release-manifest.mjs) and checked against minecraft_range / minecraft_neo_range by ./gradlew checkMcVersions (part of buildAll). Add new patch releases here when a line gains one.
